origin:
The Caterham Academy wasn't so much 'founded' as it spontaneously combusted into existence from a shared passion for raw, unfiltered motorsport. It began in the cramped garage of three mates – Dave, Sarah, and young Ollie – all united by their love for Caterham Sevens and a burning desire to prove that racing wasn't just for the deep-pocketed elite. Their initial venture involved stripping down a tired old Seven, affectionately nicknamed 'The Shed,' and entering it in local club races. Early results were… enthusiastic, often ending in spectacular spins and near-misses. But the sheer joy of it all was infectious, and the team, although barely a team at that point, was born.

Word spread through the Caterham community about the trio's antics, attracting other like-minded enthusiasts. 'The Shed' was gradually upgraded, often using parts scavenged from scrapyards or fabricated in Dave's shed (hence the name). Their first major breakthrough came during a particularly wet race at Brands Hatch; Ollie, demonstrating surprising car control, managed to clinch a podium finish, sparking a wave of excitement and attracting a small but dedicated following. This unexpected success gave them the momentum to formalize their efforts, officially becoming 'Caterham Academy' – a name chosen as much for its simplicity as its nod to their commitment to learning and improving.
philosophy: Caterham Academy believes in racing for the love of the sport. Their approach to car development is pragmatic, focusing on maximizing the performance of their existing equipment through meticulous maintenance and clever, budget-conscious upgrades. The team culture is one of camaraderie and shared effort, where everyone pitches in, regardless of their official role. The emphasis is on having fun, learning from mistakes, and celebrating even the smallest victories.
achievements: Podium finish at Brands Hatch in 2022 (Class B)
Multiple top-10 finishes in the local Caterham Seven Championship
Successfully rebuilt 'The Shed' after a major crash at Silverstone
Won the 'Spirit of the Race' award at the 2023 Oulton Park meet.

teamPrincipal.name: David 'Dave' Miller
teamPrincipal.background: Dave is a self-taught engineer with a passion for classic cars and a knack for fixing anything with an engine. He provides the team with technical expertise and keeps the atmosphere light with his infectious enthusiasm.

keyFigures.name: Sarah Chen
keyFigures.description: Sarah is the organizational backbone of the team, handling logistics, sponsorship, and keeping Dave and Ollie in line. Her meticulous planning ensures that everything runs smoothly, even on a shoestring budget.

keyFigures.name: Oliver 'Ollie' Jones
keyFigures.description: Ollie is the team's primary driver, known for his aggressive driving style and surprising talent in wet conditions. He brings a youthful energy and determination to the team.

headquarters: The team operates out of a small, rented industrial unit on the outskirts of Birmingham. Their facilities are basic, consisting of a workshop area, a small office, and a perpetually cluttered parts storage area.
fanBase: Caterham Academy's fanbase consists mainly of friends, family, and fellow Caterham enthusiasts who appreciate their down-to-earth approach and unwavering passion for motorsport. They are known for their enthusiastic support at local races, often sporting homemade team merchandise.
